OFFLINE OFFICIAL REFERENCE ONLY — no Python serving dependency.
Coordinator owns Jensen access/resource scheduling and all artifact transfers.
Do not replace global torch, drivers, mesh identities or trust stores.

Move these task-owned inputs (exclude .venv and generated local output):
- reference-oracle/{generate.py,compare_native.py,verify_artifacts.py,bootstrap_cpu.sh,requirements-cpu.lock,corpus.json}
- bf16-artifact-manifest.json
- the exact 17 pinned original files under Cloudflare/clef-flash revision
  8b2e5fd17c09fd49bc2880b805d5323ec7ff4ff3 (19.08GB). Preserve pathnames.
Verify every transferred file against the manifest SHA256 before full execution.
Do not copy the local CPU venv: bootstrap a scoped Jensen Python3.11 venv.

Task-local package pins: torch2.11.0+cpu, transformers5.10.2, tokenizers0.22.2,
safetensors0.7.0, accelerate1.15.0, pillow12.3.0, torchvision0.26.0+cpu. Full transitive pins in
requirements-cpu.lock. bootstrap_cpu.sh first installs official CPU torch wheel,
and matching CPU torchvision (required by official AutoProcessor even for text),
then pinned remaining wheels without dependency mutation; uv pip check required.
This does not touch Jensen's global incorrect CUDA torch build.

Full CPU FP32 command, AFTER coordinator confirms no other full-model process:
ORACLE_TASK_DIR=/absolute/task-owned/reference-oracle
ORACLE_MODEL_DIR=/absolute/task-owned/original-model
bash "${ORACLE_TASK_DIR}/bootstrap_cpu.sh"
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false \
  "${ORACLE_TASK_DIR}/.venv/bin/python" "${ORACLE_TASK_DIR}/generate.py" \
  --model-dir "${ORACLE_MODEL_DIR}" \
  --artifact-manifest /absolute/task-owned/bf16-artifact-manifest.json \
  --output "${ORACLE_TASK_DIR}/full-f32-cpu-v1" \
  --mode full --allow-full-model --dtype float32 --device cpu --threads 8

The full loader is the unmodified official load_release_model, followed by the
unmodified ClefModel.forward under inference_mode. Hooks ONLY observe hidden /
hidden_norm outputs; they do not change model operations. No kernel/attention
implementation override is injected; observed implementation is recorded.

Outputs: records.json (all original encoded tokens/spans/types/options/accounting),
tensors.safetensors (selected original LM embedding rows, actual backbone hidden,
head-normalized hidden, logits and Float32 probabilities), provenance.json
(source/artifact/corpus/generator and output hashes, versions, device/dtype,
threads, host, elapsed time and measured peak RSS). Log stdout/stderr separately.
Keys: embedding_token_ids,embedding_rows,r{i}.hidden,r{i}.normalized_hidden,
r{i}.q{j}.logits,r{i}.q{j}.probabilities. Full corpus has five records.

Compare native original-FP32 baseline outputs to full-f32 CPU oracle; FP8 drift
is a separate profile/gate. compare_native.py requires explicit --atol/--rtol;
no accepted tolerances are invented by the fixture generator. Include exact
encoder JSON comparison and --include-hidden for whole-port comparisons.
Head-only synthetic fixtures cannot establish backbone correctness or R5 PASS.
